title: Industrial IoT controllers (zPasteurAIzer)
summary: RaspberryPi-based industrial IoT controllers for digitizing production lines: reading process signals, pre-processing data, sending it to the cloud, executing commands.
description: Industrial IoT controllers for the digitization of production lines at the Athenian Brewery, developed in the context of the European research project zPasteurAIzer.

The controllers are industrial planning IoT devices built on the RaspberryPi platform. They receive production process signals, pre-process the data, send it to the cloud server, receive commands from the web services and execute orders in industrial automation.
The software stack is Python, Redis, MQTT, MySQL and shell scripts.
